tests.command: vendor/PATCHES.md accuracy check: replace_all_text vendor patch and C01-C06 coverage documented

C01-VENDOR-GPUI-PRE.evidence: cargo tree -p gpui-pre resolves gpui-pre v0.3.6 to vendor/gpui-pre; cargo check --workspace exits 0 with everything else from crates.io.

C02-A11Y-ACTIVATION-GATE.evidence: debug_a11y_tree_json() returns Some on a fresh window; all 7 html runtime tests assert against the published completed-frame tree and pass.

C03-NODE-BOUNDS-EXPOSURE.evidence: Window::a11y_node_bounds exposes Bounds<Pixels> from A11y::node_bounds in logical pixels; observer publishes them and runtime assertions pass.

C04-INPUT-HANDLER-EXPOSURE.evidence: PlatformInputHandler::replace_all_text plus Window::replace_input_text carry replacement without re-entrancy; replaced_text_reaches_the_document passes un-ignored and the suite reports 7 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored.

C05-POINTER-POSITION-PRESERVATION.evidence: bounds_changed preserves synthetic hover; input test synthetic_hover_survives_bounds_changed passes and all 21 gpui-mcp lib tests pass.

C06-TEXT-FALLBACK-STACK.evidence: resolve_font rebuilds fallback candidates via fallback_with_requested_traits preserving weight, style, and features; workspace check exits 0.

C07-PATCHES-DOCUMENTATION.evidence: vendor/PATCHES.md records every C01-C06 change including platform.rs replace_all_text with file, item, what it opened, and why the native API was unreachable.

risks: Only Click and Focus are advertised on accessibility nodes, so hover and scroll tools still cannot answer; non-editable text stays unpublished.
gpui-pre own test target cannot compile in-repo because vendored svg_renderer and example fonts use absent include_bytes asset paths.
